mn41:10.5: Beings who appear due to the force of past action (kamma) in some states of birth: all gods and divinities, ghosts, inhabitants of hell. See Sutta 12, para. 33. | For an explanation of these ‘there-is-not’ views held by some teachers in the Buddha-time, which were a rejection of all moral values, see ‘The Eightfold Path and its factors explained’, Wheel Publications B.P.S., Kandy, Sri Lanka.
